device: iPhone 17 simulator, iOS 27.0 (existing booted device; none created or booted)
app: dev.hjm.designsystem.showcase development client on Metro 8084 (shared with a concurrent Android audit; Metro not restarted)
sourceBase: HJM checkout f1d28a3 (release 1.8.0) plus uncommitted working-tree changes from other sessions (interaction adapters, liquid toast). Canonical renderer sources had no modification after 01:30; only interaction-adapter files changed during the audit window.
method: Screens via xcrun simctl io screenshot/recordVideo into /tmp, copied after all device interaction finished. Control and state reads via idb ui tap/swipe/text and idb ui describe-all (labels, values, traits). Long-press drag via idb gRPC HID events (touch down, 0.9 s hold, 25 stepped moves). Xcode Device Hub is running but this session had no Device Hub automation channel (the 9/29 and 9/30 adapter passes recorded timeoutReached); idb fallback approved by the user for HJM validation. No native build, no source edits, no commit.
bundleNote: The client first ran a JS bundle older than another session's 03:20 design-contracts dist rebuild, so Celebration showed only blue particles. After terminating and reopening the client on Metro 8084 (~03:38) colors matched source; all interaction-adapter checks were repeated on the fresh bundle, and the canonical findings (agreement contrast, upload-item AX, number-field AX) were re-confirmed on it.
limits: Accessibility evidence is idb accessibility-tree inspection, not a spoken VoiceOver journey.
No physical device, Release binary, other device sizes, or system text-size settings.
Stills do not establish timing; motion claims cite video frames, burst screenshots or pixel diffs.
idb text on the Korean IME can mis-compose multi-jamo input ('run' produced 'ㄱ'); tag entry claims rely on '42' and '가'.
External links (QR fallback, component docs) and Photos/provider integration were not exercised beyond in-app callbacks.
